body: The OffenhauserOur latest El Capitan–tier Sprinter 170 AWD is basically a tiny luxury apartment that decided it was tired of standing still and wanted to see the world. This rig blends high-end comfort with real off-grid capability, giving you the kind of travel freedom that makes traditional lodging feel a little… outdated.

From the insulation to the electrical system to the interior finishes, everything in this build is dialed. You get the warmth and polish of a custom-designed living space, the storage and durability of a true overland setup, and enough tech to make your house question its self-worth.

Whether you’re chasing mountains, coastlines, trailheads, or just a quiet place to brew coffee with a view, this Sprinter is built to deliver that “how is this even real?” feeling every time you step inside.
And yeah—calling it an adventure rig almost feels too modest. It’s more like a rolling basecamp disguised as a boutique studio.
Translation: run your life, your gadgets, your snacks, whatever. You’re good.
This setup laughs at winter and keeps everything flowing where it should.
Take on desert heat, mountain cold, and everything in between.
This van is ready for real travel — not pretend Instagram travel.
Soft, modern tones with rich wood and clean black accents. Chef’s kiss x2.
